en_title: 'No Amount of Competition Will Ever Unseat Steam' – Former Epic Games Engineer Rails Against Valve
cn_title: 「再多的竞争也永远无法撼动Steam的地位」——前Epic Games工程师猛烈抨击Valve
opus_summary: Epic Games前工程师Kiaran Ritchie发文批评Steam，称用户对其他商店的敌意导致PC游戏行业30%的总收入流失。他认为，即使出现更好的客户端，Steam用户仍可能偏爱将游戏库集中在一处。Epic Games近期也尝试推出启动更快的商店版本。

paragraphs.en: Epic's rivalry with Valve isn't anything new, but while it's usually CEO Tim Sweeney taking shots at Valve, an ex-engineer posted a long list of problems Steam has caused in the industry.
paragraphs.cn: Epic与Valve之间的竞争并不是什么新鲜事，但通常是CEO Tim Sweeney抨击Valve，而这次一名前工程师列出了Steam在业内造成的一长串问题。

paragraphs.en: Just last week, after posting about Valve's 30% cut that it takes off the top of game sales, ex-Epic Engineer Kiaran Ritchie wrote a long Twitter post detailing his critiques of the biggest PC games marketplace. And, really, it seems like he's throwing up his hands and accepting Valve's dominion over the ecosystem while blaming Steam users.
paragraphs.cn: 就在上周，前Epic工程师Kiaran Ritchie发帖谈及Valve从游戏销售收入中直接抽取30%分成之后，又在X上发布了一篇长帖，详细阐述了他对这个最大PC游戏商城的批评。实际上，他似乎已无奈接受了Valve对整个生态系统的主导地位，同时将责任归咎于Steam用户。

paragraphs.en: Ritchie says that, "even if an alternative were objectively better, by whatever metric you care about, it would still be of no interest to Steam users. They would in fact find it to be a problem and a threat to their investment." Specifically, he claims Steam users are hostile to other stores even existing, by saying, "Competition in this space is not only uninteresting to most Steam users, it's actively denigrated! The CONSEQUENCE of this situation, is that 30% of all gross revenue is siphoned out of the PC games industry into a black hole."
paragraphs.cn: Ritchie表示：「即使有一个替代平台，无论按你在意的哪种标准衡量都客观上更好，Steam用户仍然不会对它感兴趣。事实上，他们会觉得这是个问题，是对他们投入的威胁。」具体来说，他声称Steam用户甚至敌视其他商店的存在，他说：「这个领域的竞争不仅无法引起大多数Steam用户的兴趣，还会遭到积极贬低！这种情况的后果是，30%的总收入被从PC游戏行业中抽走，流入一个黑洞。」

paragraphs.en: Epic Games has tried its hands at unseating Steam again recently, after Tim Sweeney bragged on Twitter about vibe coding a new version of the Epic Games Store that launches faster than Steam. But, while launching quickly and letting people access their library without waiting minutes is an improvement, even Ritchie doesn't feel like it'll make much of a difference.
paragraphs.cn: 最近，在Tim Sweeney于X上炫耀通过氛围编程制作了一个启动速度比Steam更快的新版Epic Games Store之后，Epic Games又尝试撼动Steam的地位。不过，虽然快速启动、让人们无需等待数分钟就能访问游戏库是一项改进，但就连Ritchie也不觉得这会带来多大改变。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in the post, Ritchie says, "The Steam client and infrastructure is somewhere between 'not that hard' and 'trivial.' It's a download service attached to a payment processor with a smattering of services on the side. Cloud providers handle all the infrastructure these days." But even if someone makes a 'better' client, he says, "Steam users love Steam and having their whole library in one place. It works. It's dependable. It has sales, and cards, and achievements, oh my!"
paragraphs.cn: 在帖子中的另一处，Ritchie表示：「Steam客户端和基础设施介于『没那么难』和『轻而易举』之间。它是一个与支付处理系统相连的下载服务，附带少量其他服务。如今云服务提供商会处理所有基础设施。」但他说，即便有人制作了一个「更好」的客户端，「Steam用户喜欢Steam，喜欢把整个游戏库放在同一个地方。它能用。它可靠。它还有促销、卡牌和成就，哇哦！」

paragraphs.en: This all comes on top of Epic's years-long battle to lower the amount of cash marketplaces take from digital sales. Epic hasn't only fought Valve on this; the company has also taken on Apple and Google in its quest to get Fortnite on mobile devices – and then had to pay Apple $6 million , but won against Google .
paragraphs.cn: 这一切都发生在Epic多年来为降低商城从数字销售中抽取的金额而展开的斗争背景下。Epic在这件事上不只与Valve交锋；该公司还为了让Fortnite登陆移动设备，与Apple和Google展开了较量——随后不得不向Apple支付600万美元，但赢得了与Google的诉讼。

paragraphs.en: But with Valve, Epic's problem seems to be that most gamers prefer Steam outright. After all, there are dozens of game stores on PC where people can buy games, but as Ritchie points out, Steam users are happy just sticking with Valve's store. And no matter what Epic does, that probably isn't going to change .
paragraphs.cn: 但在与Valve的较量中，Epic面临的问题似乎是大多数玩家就是更喜欢Steam。毕竟，PC上有几十家游戏商店可供人们购买游戏，但正如Ritchie指出的那样，Steam用户乐于继续使用Valve的商店。而无论Epic做什么，这一点可能都不会改变。
